caption: A downward parabola's vertex is its global maximum
An odd-degree polynomial is unbounded above
With 0 <= x <= 1, the unconstrained vertex (x = 2) is out of range -- the boundary wins
Exp(-x) grows without bound as x -> -Infinity
Sqrt(4 - x^2)'s domain is exactly [-2, 2] -- its vertex (x = 0) is the max
Declines -- multivariate optimization is out of scope
